# Unified launcher, Homegarden, rail and Essence implementation plan

Planning agent, 2026-10-09. Based on the complete preserved owner entry, all three exploration reports, repository AGENTS.md, and `akr context --goal legeos.work.unified-launcher-homegarden-20261009`. This is a scratch implementation plan, not durable project authority. Root owns its conversion into typed AKR records and all validation. Baseline is `f8b45b7`; current native OS is TemplarOS, with Lubuntu recovery only.

## Outcome and invariants

Deliver passes A–D in this task. One focused PixelKit launcher overlay discovers apps/files; Homegarden shows working environments; the applications bar/gesture rail combines real tasks and intentional saved launch profiles. Ordinary activation never creates a tile or file reference. Both gesture directions and the system rail retain their behavior. File results preserve native bytes and open through Associations1/Launcher1; directories use the selected FileManager provider. TaskKey, verified app identity, groups, first-seen task ordering, Index1 paging/freshness/cancellation, and Home's existing file-pane rules remain authoritative.

The old Home Apps-only launcher/FSearch and adaptive omnibox presentation decisions conflict with the owner's new direction. Root must supersede/revise those typed decisions/work items with child dispositions, while preserving unrelated Files browsing and historical evidence. The exploration context's stale observations are warnings to check against code, not proof of new defects. The exact new goal context is clean.

## Ownership and coordination

Use root plus three implementation agents. Agents may add meaningful tests to their source but never run them. Root alone runs tests/builds/checks, uses OptMem, mutates AKR, commits and integrates. No live desktop operations, service restarts, deployments, global input injection, or bypass of the nested-session refusal.

| Owner | Exclusive source responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Root integration | `surface/app.rs`; shell `wayland_bridge.rs`; shell module registration (`lib.rs`, `surface/mod.rs`); search worker/update lifecycle; common activation/recency/favorite matching; compositor-control client convenience and CLI Search Here caller; command/broker/field dispatch; parent test harness/integration; ledger/source decisions/evidence |
| UI/model lane | New `launcher_model.rs`, `surface/launcher_screen.rs`; Home search/recents removal in `field_screen.rs`; reusable result painting and retired FSearch row/footer in `omnibox.rs` and `omnibox_screen.rs`; launcher context menus in `context_menu.rs`; Home tests/harness updates |
| Config/settings/rail lane | `templar-types/src/launcher.rs`, its types lib export; `templar-types/src/settings.rs` and `action.rs`; session-core settings/provider validation; Settings1 service, client proxy and D-Bus/interface documentation for atomic metadata update; Settings GUI/backend; new `rail_model.rs` and `bar_screen.rs`; FSearch provider/fork packaging retirement and current packaging docs |
| Compositor/effects lane | Compositor motion/scene/GLES effect renderer/backends/state; keybindings/focus input; `templar-window` focused-popup ordering; compositor-control request enum/handler; Wayland XML; compositor dependencies; effects shader/shared planner changes if needed; compositor/effect source tests |

No lane edits another lane's file without a message and explicit handoff. Root integrates shared call sites. Publish shared config and launcher/rail contracts first; UI and rail lane can then work concurrently with root host wiring and compositor integration. The config lane owns action declarations, UI lane owns menu pointer references; agree action IDs before either edit. Root owns Wayland client bridge, compositor lane owns server/XML and reports enum values/since-version to root.

## Shared contracts (freeze before broad implementation)

### Persistent launcher metadata

Pure `templar_types::launcher` supplies `LauncherMode::{Apps, Files}` (shared with compositor control, re-exported by shell launcher_model), `FavoriteId` (stable string), `Favorite { id, label, target }`, `FavoriteTarget::{App { app_id: String }, Terminal { app_id: String, cwd_b64: String, arguments: Vec<String> }}`, `LauncherVisibility { hidden_apps: BTreeSet<String>, hidden_paths_b64: BTreeSet<String> }`, and `LauncherPreferences { favorites: Vec<Favorite>, aliases: BTreeMap<String,String>, visibility }`. Aliases use canonical keys `app:<canonical-id>` or `path:<canonical-base64>`; they never become launch targets. Preference JSON lives in `shell.launcher.preferences`, a typed JSON Str key following existing wallpaper precedents. Validate stable unique IDs, bounded collections/text/argv, valid AppId, canonical base64, absolute native cwd/path and absence of NUL. Missing mounted cwd is activation-time availability, not a reason to discard persistence. Deduplicate plain App favorites; terminal profiles remain distinct.

Add an additive narrow `Settings1.UpdateLauncherV1(command_json, origin) -> preferences_json` service method plus typed `LauncherMutation` commands (upsert/remove/reorder favorite, set/clear alias, hide/restore canonical identity). Apply mutation to the latest stored value within Settings1's store/schema/values transaction/lock order; validate, commit existing history/undo/audit and emit Changed. Refactor shared setting-commit code rather than calling Set while holding its lock. Both shell and Settings GUI call this method, so stale cross-client read/modify/write cannot erase unrelated metadata. Keep generic Set/read/reset compatibility; normal GUI edits send granular mutations. Publish method/proxy/signature docs together.

### Launcher model and view

`launcher_model.rs` exposes:

- `LauncherMode::{Apps, Files}`.
- `LauncherTarget::{App(AppId), File(PathBuf), Directory(PathBuf), Favorite(FavoriteId)}` with a canonical identity helper and no display-string targeting.
- `LauncherRow { target, label, detail, icon_id: Option<String>, running: bool, section: Option<&'static str>, size_bytes: Option<u64>, mtime_ms: Option<i64> }` (section is Favorites/Recent Applications/Recent Files; a nonblank query has ranked rows without sections).
- `LauncherState { open, mode, query, highlighted, generation, scope: Option<PathBuf> }` with `show(mode, scope, query)`, `switch_mode()` (retains text), query change invalidation and `dismiss()`; every new lifecycle/query/mode/scope invalidates generation. Root uses the same token when starting/accepting async search. Preserve selected canonical target when applicable instead of relying solely on an index.

`LauncherScreen` owns that state, text/IME, scrolling, ContextMenu, frozen menu target and alias/info dialogs. Provide state()/state_mut(), focus_search(), ime_caret(), visible_range(), transient reset and `draw(ui, area, &LauncherData) -> Vec<LauncherAction>`. `LauncherData.rows` is `&[Option<LauncherRow>]` retaining Index1 source-slot positions; other fields include icons/search notice/loading/now_ms. A None slot is disabled/loading, has no fake actionable native path, and keyboard highlight/scroll can demand its page. Apps/recent results are contiguous Some rows; hidden/absent file rows may need a disabled source slot or an explicit source-index map so paging offsets remain correct. Root creates rows and handles actions. Final signatures can be adjusted lane-to-lane before edits, without changing ownership.

Actions are `Open { target, intent: omnibox_screen::Intent }`, `QueryChanged`, `SwitchMode`, `Dismiss`, `Context { id: &'static str, target }`, `SetAlias { target, label }`, plus visible-range demand if needed. `Intent::Open` is click/Enter, LaunchNew is Ctrl+Enter, ShowAll is Right on an application. Handle Tab/Escape before text widget/omnibox key consumption; Tab toggles mode and never emits Taskfield. Context click precedes click and freezes cloned target; Open never starts drag preparation. Menu IDs: `launcher.pin-rail`, `launcher.add-home`, `launcher.rename-alias`, `launcher.info`, `launcher.hide` (Delete uses hide), `launcher.restore`. Use ContextMenu.open_rows_at so Home menu-target enums need not absorb arbitrary search targets. Info and alias dialogs stay read-only/metadata-only with explicit commit/cancel.

UI lane adds `omnibox::Scope::LauncherFiles(Option<PathBuf>)` and updates its own exhaustive matches. Root updates app.rs scope matches. Preserve existing location-scoped browse search if still used, but the launcher admits empty within for everywhere. Reuse pure row painters/typography; avoid omnibox::federate re-sorting app_search's recency ranking.

Home entry action is `FieldAction::ShowLauncher { mode, scope, query }` (or a single LauncherRequest payload). Bare-Home printable input opens the common popup with its initial text, and Home context menu/explicit shortcut action opens it blank. Do not retain a hidden independent Home search state/popup after removing chrome.

### Rail projection

Leave `taskbar::entries_in` and genuine TaskUnits as running authority. New pure `rail_model` projects `RailEntry { slot: RailSlot, task: Option<taskbar::Entry>, icon_id, label, lane, profile_window: Option<WindowId> }`; `RailSlot::{Running(TaskKey), Favorite(FavoriteId), Launcher}`. Reconcile from real entries, ordered preferences, app/variant identity mapping and host-verified profile window matches. Running plain app favorite has one slot with the real Entry backing it; unmatched favorite has no invented TaskUnit. Preserve groups as groups, never steal a member from a mixed group. Unknown claimed identities never merge. Keep group-first and remaining tasks' first-seen relative order; saved favorite order remains stable through start/exit. Explicitly test this placement policy.

`BarData.entries` becomes `&[RailEntry]`; draw/geometry/rows/fan/hover/deadline/opaque-shape/rail-length calls all consume that same projection. Actual task fans/group actions use `task`, saved terminal profiles activate their precise profile target, launcher has no fan. `BarAction::OpenLauncher` and `OpenFavorite(FavoriteId)` route to root. Provide rail rows calculation equivalent to existing lane rows; do not pass favorites only into drawing while sizing from tasks. Root resets transient indices when projected slot identities change. Both classic island and Apps gesture rail inherit the feature together.

### Animation propagation

Config lane adds `shell.appearance.window-transition` choice off/simple/essence (default essence) and `shell.appearance.particle-size` int 1–24 (default 6). Existing `shell.home-field.reduced-motion` is the single override. Compositor lane adds guarded Wayland v15 `set_window_transition(kind, particle_size)` request/enum and bumps manager/list/toplevel XML consistently; root bridge guards version and sends committed values on connect/change. Off/reduced motion cancel existing transitions; grain updates change Style/uniforms without replanning. Shader/capture/allocation/context failure automatically selects existing simple 200ms motion.

## Pass A — global overlay and direct activation

1. UI lane builds pure model and fixed 720x480-ish launcher view, list scroll, focused Apps input, blank favorites/recents and direct contracts; removes Home's permanent search/recents reservation and result-to-tile drag paths while preserving actual tile/work-card drag.
2. Root adds one `Option<HostedWindow>` and one screen to ShellApp. `show_launcher(request)` creates a transparent undecorated ShellOverlay, zero bottom exclusive zone, Centre alignment, size clamped to output. Paint/commit first frame before focus request. Use the calendar's focus synchronization; if mapping races a first commit, compositor provides a narrowly owned pending focus fulfilled on mapped commit, rather than silently assuming focus succeeded.
3. Route all launcher events including keyboard/modifiers, pointer/context click/wheel, IME preedit/commit/disabled, resize/scale, accessibility and Focused(false). Dismiss releases borrowed focus, invalidates/cancels search and drops/unmaps the surface. On lock/bridge loss do the same. Release after outside click must not steal the new target's focus. No per-result resize.
4. Compositor removes RevealLauncher's Home reveal; validate actual Super chord state restoration, not just the action arm. Add focused-popup stacking promotion so global launcher also works over fullscreen without globally promoting passive rails or changing active app/geometry/MRU. Clear promotion on release/focus loss/unmap/disconnect/lock.
5. Root's common target activation chooses semantic MRU verified canonical app window, including parked/grouped windows, restoring it through existing window bridge without regrouping. Normal launch only if no suitable window; Ctrl+Enter explicitly new instance. Right opens existing app windows. Record meaningful verified activations once, including compositor activation change; do not rewrite recents every frame or trust unknown claims. Reuse app_search ranking/filter hidden; favorites first then deduplicated recents on blank query.

Checkpoint: pure launcher click/Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Tab/Escape/context, Home no implicit creation, compositor focus/Home state and above-maximized/fullscreen semantics pass before retirement removes alternative file routing.

## Pass B — Index1, metadata contexts and FSearch retirement

1. Root reuses existing debounce/request/search-results/SearchPages pipeline with explicit owner Scope::LauncherFiles(scope), rather than copying a second cursor/paging implementation. Mode/query/lifecycle generation and exact scope guard every response/page; close successful rejected sessions. Empty within is allowed for typed Files everywhere; scoped Search Here passes its directory. Blank Files uses already-known native recent files/folders and starts no empty-index query.
2. Preserve paged demand near visible range, retained totals/unknown/truncated notices, absence/freshness metadata, SnapshotRequired bounded refresh with selection/scroll continuity, cursor identity/service generation and cancellation safety. Close cursors on replacement, switch, dismiss, lock/disconnect. Native identity comes from IndexHit.path, never display text.
3. Open file through existing data::brokered_file_open / Associations1→Launcher1; open directories via selected FileManager provider with native URI. Include path, modified time and size where available; do not claim unavailable metadata is current.
4. Root handles explicit context actions: pin-rail writes favorite; add-home uses existing PinApp/folder placement/reference-pane operations and no loose file tile on bare Home; alias/hide mutate launcher metadata only; info uses catalogue/index metadata. A file reference creates/selects an intentional Shortcuts pane if needed through existing field-model operations. Hiding filters immediately and never calls filesystem operations or HomeGarden.Hide. Settings Unhide calls the same mutation boundary.
5. Search Here in FileVerbRequest calls common popup Files scope+query. Config/action lane removes FileSearch provider requirements, default inference and graphical provider choice. Keep legacy role encoding readable if compatibility requires it. Deliver the external file-manager route through the existing authenticated local Unix JSON compositor-control channel: compositor/effects lane adds `ControlRequest::OpenLauncher { mode: LauncherMode, scope_uri: Option<String>, query: String }`, validates mode/length/native local URI and forwards an additive v15 `launcher_request(mode, scope_uri, query)` event to the one shell channel. Use wire mode Apps=0/Files=1, empty scope URI means everywhere. Root adds client convenience, CLI `launcher/search-here` entry and bridge receipt, all converging on show_launcher. Config/packaging lane adds the shipped PCManFM Search Here action calling that CLI with a native directory argument/URI. Do not launch an alternate search process or use a new D-Bus popup service. Document/gate the control enum and protocol versions together; receive old launcher_focus as Apps everywhere for compatibility.
6. Once replacement passes the checkpoint, remove SEARCH_EVERYWHERE/footer/search_everywhere/--search delegation and FSearch fork manifest/package sources. Search installer/seeds/deploy for dependency closure. Preserve Index1 and compatibility interfaces, historical immutable archive evidence and unrelated providers. Root supersedes old ledger plans/decisions; current maintained docs get dated new direction, never edit docs/generated.

## Pass C — favorites/profiles and common rail

1. Config lane delivers validated persistent profiles, atomic mutations and dedicated Settings favorite editor (app choice, label, absolute directory, argument list with literal argv semantics), reorder/remove, alias management and hidden app/native-path restore controls. JSON text alone is not the product editor.
2. Root watches launcher config before initial reads, updates launcher/rail on Changed, and calls atomic metadata mutations. Track profile launch's returned InstanceId in host; resolve it to verified windows. For default argv profiles, verified WorkingDirectoriesV1 native cwd+canonical app may match existing instances. Arbitrary argv profile matching only uses tracked InstanceId, since titles/current APIs cannot prove arguments. Keep native host cwd map rather than only FieldScreen's private map.
3. Profile activation prefers its matching semantic MRU instance, otherwise passes literal argv plus encoded native directory URI to Launcher1.LaunchInDirectoryV1. Do not persist windows/InstanceIds or construct terminal-specific flags/shell commands. Report missing cwd/provider/launch failure without losing the favorite.
4. Root computes one rail projection used by all size/draw/hover methods and dispatches saved/plain/running targets through the same host activation. Preserve TaskKey fans/groups and terminal lanes. UI lane supplies Homegarden context/shortcut route to same global launcher; no second embedded search.

## Pass D — Settings organization and production Essence

Settings:

1. Append Launcher/Advanced page values without changing existing discriminants/deep-link slugs. Present ten top-level groups from the owner proposal; preserve independent service ownership and child page state. Route old links into their appropriate group. Ctrl+Page traversal remains coherent.
2. Move throw, Homegarden half-life/max-contexts, gate geometry/lanes and preview update rate to Advanced. Show preview rate only when live previews enabled. Keep original reduced-motion key under Appearance. Mark unconsumed shell.dock.grouping/resources.mode Unsupported with reason in Inspect; retain legacy stored compatibility. Remove ordinary FSearch/Home-search controls.
3. System becomes concise status with destination links for sound/display controls, preserving battery/power/notifications. Verify Displays owns an effective brightness control before removing the only working control; add it there if necessary. Restructure Appearance generated form to make both animation controls reachable beside wallpaper. Enabled controls need audited runtime consumers and tests demonstrating effect; unsupported legacy controls remain honest.

Essence GPU implementation (deliver now, not a future stub):

1. Extend pure MotionState with Simple or Essence transition carrying stable effect ID, Arc<Plan>, Run and timing. Keep public simple geometry/fallback where current callers rely on it. At existing start_shelf_motions funnel, plan once from logical output/window/card geometry and other visible app rectangles. Advance then reverse the existing Run and reuse Arc<Plan>/GPU resources on quick park/unpark reversal. Off/reduced-motion skip/cancel; destruction/output removal prune safely.
2. Add compositor EssenceRenderer context-local cache using the existing GlesRenderer/MultiRenderer access pattern from wallpaper. Capture full moving surface tree once into a bounded offscreen GlesTexture using surface render elements and Offscreen/Bind; include subsurfaces/transforms. Stop before screencopy's ExportMem/readback tail. Never add wgpu device or CPU framebuffer readback.
3. Hand-port Essence body/dissolve/field and Catmull-Rom mote shaders to actual GLSL ES100. Use custom pixel shader for body and one GPU mote batch with six expanded vertices per mote (corner/path/time attributes) through existing GlesFrame.with_context; no dependence on instancing extension and no per-mote draw calls. Cache compile/link failure per context. GLSL constant loops/selection avoid ES100 dynamic indexing issues. Grain is per-frame Style uniform default 6, not a new movement plan.
4. Prefer rendering body+batch into a transparent bounded effect texture on the existing GLES device, represented as one ordinary SceneElement; this reuses native crop/scale/mirror/calibration and multisurface composition. Alternatively direct element is acceptable only if src/dst/projection/damage/scissor mapping is fully implemented. Insert at the moving window's original Surface slot, omit its ordinary surface/chrome and keep upper windows occluding it. Plan obstacle masks protect visible gaps. Opaque regions empty; progress/style updates advance damage commit; direct scanout cannot bypass effect.
5. Preserve premultiplied One/OneMinusSrcAlpha blending; restore raw GL state, defer deletion/context-safe cleanup, enforce texture/mote bounded resource limits, clear on finish/lock/blank/context loss. Capability/init/capture/allocation/draw failure switches that transition to simple motion; never retry failed shader every frame. Integrate in winit, udev and native-worker paths, not only sandbox/check backend. Materials/surface shader and bar plate motion are outside this change.

## Parent-only validation and completion

Run targeted gates at each completed pass, then final combined checks. Tests should distinguish behaviors, not mirror implementation:

- Model/UI: lifecycle generation fencing; Tab text retention and no ShowAll; click only Open/no FieldOp; Enter versus Ctrl+Enter; Right app windows; Escape; context click/frozen target; alias/hide/create explicit; fixed geometry across async row counts; keyboard scrolling/page demand.
- Search/broker: everywhere versus Search Here within; blank Files no Index1 query; late close/reopen/mode response closes cursor; wrong-page cursor rejected; bounded SnapshotRequired; non-UTF8 file through Associations1→LaunchFiles; hidden result restored without touching a temp file; directory provider routing.
- Shared/rail: non-UTF8 profile persistence/mutations; malformed/relative/NUL paths and duplicate IDs rejected; atomic concurrent distinct metadata edits retained; favorites/running app one slot; groups/unknown identities unaffected; profiles distinct and argv matching honest; geometry counts every slot; recents on verified activation once.
- Settings: old deep links/stable discriminants; Unhide/favorite editors use metadata only; moved controls still available; preview-rate dependency; unsupported legacy keys explain capability; animation settings change compositor policy/style.
- Compositor: real Super+Space chord over maximized/fullscreen preserves Home/geometry/activation/MRU; mapped popup focus and promotion; actual outside press chooses app/Home/empty focus and delayed release doesn't steal it; cleanup on unmap/disconnect/lock. Pure motion tests assert same Arc plan on reverse, continuity, cheap grain update, reduced-motion/off and fallback.
- Production GPU: owned surfaceless EGL/pbuffer harness compiles/links the exact ES100 shaders and renders disposable patterned texture at several progress/grain sizes; test alpha/occlusion and forced shader-failure simple fallback. Report unavailable EGL as a skipped qualification, not GPU success. Comp --check alone proves no rendering behavior.

Commands: native `scripts/cargo-native.sh test` targeted packages `templar-types`, `templar-session-core`, `templar-shell`, `templar-settings`, `templar-appd`, `templar-comp`, `templar-window`, `templar-effects`; formatting; xtask action/packaging/interfaces/interface-signatures/proxies/Wayland-version gates; shell offscreen render and comp --check. Exact commands follow actual repository CLI discovery. Broaden testing only for cross-cutting failures/new changes.

If safe owned fixture infrastructure exists, run the full private display+private session bus/catalogue/index journey: maximized app, Super+Space, immediate text, Tab, native file, Associations/Launcher activation, no Home reveal; outside dismiss and park/restore/rapid reversal GPU frames. Never claim installed/physical Intel/NVIDIA/output/performance qualification from headless fixtures; owner-run deploy/logout/installed checks remain explicitly listed. Do not bypass nested-session's live-session guard.

Root records observed results in evidence_add (facts, not claims of what they verify), completes acceptance only with actual evidence, validates AKR, and records durable new behavior in OptMem. If external qualification remains unavailable, report it plainly and keep any corresponding acceptance unchecked rather than marking everything complete. Final handoff states implemented behavior, native checks, material external limits, and clean commit status.
